issue.body:
## Problem

`sample-kit clean --help` says `Removes all files.` Clean only removes cached files.

## Fix

Change the help line to `Removes cached files.`

## Done when

- [ ] `clean --help` prints the new line.

Out of scope: any other help line.

pr.title: docs(sample-kit): correct the clean help text
pr.body: Fixes the clean help line to say it removes cached files.
